answer_1.quote: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have enhanced the performance of multihop question answering (MHQA) systems, enabling them to address complex reasoning tasks.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers to multihop questions and intermediate reasoning steps (sub-questions and step-answers).

answer_2.quote: We adopt the F1 and PSE-G F1 as our evaluation metrics.

answer_3.quote: Given that powerful LLMs have been proven to have near-human-level performance as judges (Wang et al., 2023), we use powerful LLMs to evaluate the final answers and supplement the dataset with the final answers evaluated as correct.

answer_4.quote: We evaluate the quality of the preprocessed data through human or programmatic evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: Human evaluation assessed correctness of intermediate reasoning steps (plans and step-answers).
